N° 14Farming and networking game2026

Racines & Réseaux

A pixel-art farming and business game set in Cameroon. You return to your grandfather's farm, farm the land, trade in the towns, live the life of the Bandjoun Kingdom and bring the internet to schools and cooperatives through real network troubleshooting labs.

Visit the site ↗How to useIn motion

01

Problem

Farming games are loved around the world, yet almost none take place in Africa, and fewer still teach anything true about it. Young Cameroonians abroad know little of the crops, crafts, markets and customs of their parents' villages, and network engineering is rarely shown as a trade that can change a village.

02

What it does

You clear, till, plant, water and harvest on Grandfather's farm in the Centre, then travel to the Bandjoun Kingdom in the West, the heart of the game: the chefferie and its great hut, the market of the eight-day week, the artisans' quarter, the coffee cooperative and the family compound. You trade in Bafoussam, Foumban, Douala, Penja and Yaoundé, process crops into products worth more, join a tontine, attend funerals, a dowry ceremony and festivals, and help friends who make herbal products from your harvests. Network labs ask you to diagnose and fix a real fault, such as a school with no internet, and score your method. The rulers in the story are fictional, and sacred rites are shown only from the outside.

03

How it is built

Godot 4 in GDScript, with every crop, item, recipe, market, character, quest and article stored as bilingual JSON data. The pixel art and the audio are original and generated by Python scripts. A network simulator models DHCP, DNS, NAT, VLANs and Wi-Fi for the labs. Automated tests replay the whole story from the first quest to check that no quest can get stuck. The web version is a Godot export hosted on Vercel; the Windows version runs without installation.
